heading.en: A whole CPU on one chip

hook.en: The first electronic computers filled whole rooms. In the 1970s the entire processing unit shrank onto one fingernail-sized chip: the microprocessor. The Intel 8085 is the one we study.
hook.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನಿಕ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳು ಇಡೀ ಕೋಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ತುಂಬುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು. 1970 ರ ದಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೀ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಣಾ ಘಟಕ ಉಗುರಿನಷ್ಟು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಚಿಪ್‌ಗೆ ಇಳಿಯಿತು: ಅದೇ ಮೈಕ್ರೋಪ್ರೊಸೆಸರ್. ನಾವು ಇಂಟೆಲ್ 8085 ಅನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ.

objectives.en: Define microprocessor and microcomputer and the three buses
Describe the functional blocks of the 8085
State the registers and the five flags of the 8085

narration.en: The first electronic computers filled whole rooms. In the 1970s the entire processing unit shrank onto one fingernail-sized chip: the microprocessor. The Intel 8085 is the one we study.
narration.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನಿಕ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳು ಇಡೀ ಕೋಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ತುಂಬುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು. 1970 ರ ದಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೀ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಣಾ ಘಟಕ ಉಗುರಿನಷ್ಟು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಚಿಪ್‌ಗೆ ಇಳಿಯಿತು: ಅದೇ ಮೈಕ್ರೋಪ್ರೊಸೆಸರ್. ನಾವು ಇಂಟೆಲ್ 8085 ಅನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: A microprocessor is a programmable, clock-driven integrated circuit that contains the central processing unit (ALU, registers, control) on a single chip. Together with memory (ROM, RAM) and input/output devices it forms a microcomputer. The parts are connected by three buses: the address bus (unidirectional, from the microprocessor, selects a memory location or I/O port), the data bus (bidirectional, carries data) and the control bus (read, write and other timing signals). The 8085 is an 8-bit microprocessor: its data bus and ALU handle 8 bits, and its 16-bit address bus addresses $2^{16}$ = 65 536 locations (64 KB).

points.en: Address bus: unidirectional; data bus: bidirectional

narration.en: A microprocessor is a CPU on a single chip. With memory and input-output it becomes a microcomputer, joined by the address, data and control buses. The 8085 has an 8-bit data bus and a 16-bit address bus.
narration.kn: ಮೈಕ್ರೋಪ್ರೊಸೆಸರ್ ಒಂದೇ ಚಿಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ CPU. ಸ್ಮರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು I/O ಸೇರಿದರೆ ಮೈಕ್ರೋಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್. 8085 ಗೆ 8-ಬಿಟ್ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಬಸ್ ಮತ್ತು 16-ಬಿಟ್ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬಸ್.

say.en: Draw the internal bus first. Every block hangs from it: accumulator, flags, ALU and the register array.

text.en: B C   D E   H L

say.en: The instruction register and decoder tell the timing and control unit what to do. Externally the 8085 has a 16-bit address bus and an 8-bit data bus.
Now the flag register: eight bits, but only five are used. Learn their positions.
Each flag is set by the result of the last arithmetic or logical operation.

body.en: The 8085 contains: an ALU with the accumulator (A), a temporary register and the flag register; six 8-bit general-purpose registers B, C, D, E, H, L that can be paired as BC, DE and HL; two 16-bit registers, the stack pointer (SP) and the program counter (PC, which holds the address of the next instruction); the instruction register and decoder; the timing and control unit; interrupt control; serial I/O control; and address and address/data buffers. The flag register has five flags: Sign (S, D7), Zero (Z, D6), Auxiliary carry (AC, D4), Parity (P, D2) and Carry (CY, D0).

points.en: Accumulator A: one operand and the result of ALU operations
B, C, D, E, H, L → pairs BC, DE, HL
PC: next instruction address; SP: top of stack
Flags: S, Z, AC, P, CY

narration.en: Inside the 8085 are the ALU with the accumulator and flags, six general registers that pair up as B C, D E and H L, the sixteen-bit program counter and stack pointer, and the timing and control unit.
narration.kn: 8085 ಒಳಗೆ ಅಕ್ಯುಮ್ಯುಲೇಟರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಗ್‌ಗಳಿರುವ ALU, BC, DE, HL ಜೋಡಿಗಳಾಗುವ ಆರು ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟರ್‌ಗಳು, 16-ಬಿಟ್ PC ಮತ್ತು SP, ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಘಟಕ ಇವೆ.

heading.en: Flags in order: S Z AC P CY

body.en: From D7 down: Sign (D7), Zero (D6), Auxiliary carry (D4), Parity (D2), Carry (D0). The used bits are 7, 6, 4, 2, 0.

narration.en: Flags in order: S Z AC P CY. From D7 down: Sign (D7), Zero (D6), Auxiliary carry (D4), Parity (D2), Carry (D0). The used bits are 7, 6, 4, 2, 0.

problem.en: How many memory locations can the 8085 address, and what is the address range in hexadecimal?

narration.en: Let us work this out together. How many memory locations can the 8085 address, and what is the address range in hexadecimal?

problem.en: The 8085 adds 80H and 80H. Find the result in the accumulator and the S, Z, AC, P and CY flags.

steps.en: 80H + 80H = 100H; the accumulator keeps 8 bits: 00H, and the ninth bit goes to CY = 1.
Lower nibbles 0 + 0 give no carry from bit 3: AC = 0.
00H has zero 1s, an even number: P = 1.
